title: Cross-KIC EIT Entrepreneurial Education & Skills Business Plan 2026
Climate-smart use of wood in the construction sector to support the New European Bauhaus
Beschreibung: The construction sector is central to Europe's climate transition. At the same time, significant volumes of hardwood, residual wood, low-quality wood, and damaged wood remain until today underutilised. Unlocking this potential can reduce waste, strengthen local value chains, and create sustainable economic opportunities. The WoodStock grants support this transition by supporting one-year projects that combine innovation, circularity, and community engagement — embedding the New European Bauhaus (NEB) values of together, sustainable, and beautiful into practical construction solutions. Funding may be used for one or more of the following activities : Demonstration : Prototyping, experimental set-up of innovations related to WoodStock. Testing : Physical and mechanical validation, certification preparation. Co-creation : Activities with local actors and users to improve the solution and embed them in the local value chain and community. Training : Workshops to develop new skills and knowledge. title: Specialised education programmes in key capacity areas
Beschreibung: The procedure follows the principles of: transparency, equal treatment, confidentiality, absence of conflict of interest. Admissibility and eligibility checks precede scoring; only eligible applications will be scored. Eligible proposals are ranked by total score within the available budget. The final award decision is endorsed by POLI.design. All applicants will receive a written justification for the decision, with terms to appeal. Selected beneficiaries will be requested to sign a Financial Support Agreement specifying the supported activity, eligible costs, maximum amount, payment schedule and reporting obligations. Failure to sign within the indicated timeframe may lead to loss of the grant by the autonomous decision of POLI.design. Payments will be made by POLI.design, normally after participation in the activity and approval of the beneficiary report and cost statement. Details are provided in the individual Financial Support Agreement (including e.g. the possibility of small prefinancing in justified cases).
